DECLARATIONOFZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENT by LAFAYETTE-BOYNTONAPARTMENTCORPORATION and HP LAFAYETTE-BOYNTON HOUSING DEVELOPMENT FUND COMPANY, INC.,aS nominee Real Property: Lots20and30inBlock3623 on the Tax Map of The City of NewYork for Bronx County, NewYork Record and Return to: Lafayette Global B LLC 118-35QueensBoulevard ForestHills,NewYork11375

DECLARATIONOFZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENT THIS DECLARATION OF ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT made as of this 1Ith day of     DEVELOPMENT FUND COMPANY, INC., as nominee (the “HDFC"), a New York not-for- profit corporation established pursuant to Article XI of the New York State Private Housing Finance Law,having an office at 242 West 36th Street, 3rd Floor, New York,New York 10018 and LAFAYETTE-BOYNTON APARTMENT CORPORATION("LBAC"and together with HDFC, the “Declarant"), a corporation organized and existing under the laws of the State of New York, having an office at 118-35 Queens Boulevard, Forest Hills, NY 11375. RECITALS: A. HDFC is the fee owner of the parcel of real estate and the improvements thereon designated as Lot 20("Parcel A")in Block 3623 on the Tax Map of The City of NewYork for Bronx County, New York (the “Tax Map"), described in Exhibit A annexed hereto, and which is adjacent toParcel B. B.HDFC is the fee owner of the parcel of real estate and the improvements thereon designated as Lot 30 ("Parcel B") in Block 3623 on the Tax Map described in Exhibit B annexed hereto, and which is adjacent to Parcel A. C. LBAC is the equitable and beneficial owner of Parcel A and Parcel B pursuant to that certain Declaration of Interest and Nominee Agreement dated as of October 27, 2011 and recorded on November 11,2011 in CRFN 2011000401069 in the City Register of the City ofNewYork. D.Declarant orits successor intends to construct a newbuilding or buildings on Parcel B and additions thereto not prohibited by the provisions of this Declaration, hereinafter referred to collectively as the “New Building"). E. Parcel A and Parcel B comprise a single “zoning lot,” as such term is defined in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution (such single zoning lot, as the same may be enlarged or otherwise modified from time to time, being herein called the “Combined Zoning Lot"). F.The parties hereto intend, pursuant to this Declaration, to: (i) provide for the related grants the portion of the Development Rights appurtenant to the Combined Zoning Lot which may be utilized in connection with each of Parcel A and Parcel B, and (ii) otherwise establish, and set forth, certain rights and obligations of the parties hereto. 1
